# The ranking the app's test database is built with (OmnomnomTests/Fixtures/foods.sqlite,
# README.md, "Tests"): the FDC fixtures' foods, most common first. The shipped list is
# written against the European tables and matches none of them, and OmnomnomTests checks
# popularity figures and the order they give.
Apples, raw, with skin
Bananas, raw
Egg, whole, raw, fresh
Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat, with added vitamin D
Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked
Bread, whole-wheat, commercially prepared
